description: Highlight key insights with dynamic warning icons Warning helps flag important data points for your users by displaying an icon only when specific conditions are met. Instead of cluttering your report with unnecessary alerts, Warning preserves space by appearing only when values reach critical thresholds. For example, if tracking Debt, you can set Warning to display an alert only when it exceeds a certain level. If it remains within a safe range, no icon appears, keeping your report focused on what matters most. Why choose Viz Data for Power BI? We design beautiful and highly functional custom visuals that seamlessly blend into your Power BI reports while maintaining the polish of PowerPoint and modern web design. Our aim is to make all our visuals easier to use than standard visuals.
